<script>
// Function to get cookies by name
function getCookie(name) {
    const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
    const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
    if (parts.length === 2) return parts.pop().split(';').shift();
    return ''; // Return empty string if cookie not found
}

// Parse query parameters
const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const orderReference = urlParams.get('orderReference') || 'unknown';
const email = urlParams.get('email') || 'not-provided';
const phone = urlParams.get('phone') || 'not-provided';
const amount = parseFloat(urlParams.get('amount')) || 0; // Default to 0 if not provided
const currency = urlParams.get('currency') || 'unknown';
const issuerBankCountry = urlParams.get('issuerBankCountry') || 'unknown';
const fbc = urlParams.get('_fbc') || getCookie('_fbc'); // Try to get from query, fallback to cookie
const fbp = urlParams.get('_fbp') || getCookie('_fbp'); // Try to get from query, fallback to cookie

// Log the extracted data for debugging
console.log('Data extracted: ', {
    orderReference,
    email,
    phone,
    amount,
    currency,
    issuerBankCountry,
    fbc,
    fbp
});

// Check if all required parameters are present
if (orderReference !== 'unknown' && amount > 0 && currency !== 'unknown') {
    // Trigger Facebook Pixel Purchase Event
    fbq('track', 'Purchase', {
        content_ids: orderReference,
        currency: currency,
        value: amount,
        email: email,
        phone: phone,
        country: issuerBankCountry, // Map issuerBankCountry to country
        fbc: fbc, // Facebook Click ID
        fbp: fbp, // Facebook Browser ID
        event_id: orderReference // Use the same event_id for deduplication with CAPI
    });
    console.log('Facebook Pixel Purchase event sent');

    // Trigger GA4 Purchase Event with only the required fields
    gtag('event', 'purchase', {
        currency: currency,
        value: amount,
        transaction_id: orderReference
    });
    console.log('GA4 Purchase event sent');
} else {
    console.warn('Missing required parameters. Skipping event tracking.');
}

// Redirect to Telegram after a short delay
setTimeout(() => {
    window.location.href = 'https://t.me/onlyFans_course_bot?start=67dd392a3c9d80c3ee009047';
}, 500);
</script>
